newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit Conrowa debuts at HK$1.40.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit Conrowa debuts at HK$1.40.

text.p: Shares of Leading Spirit Conrowa Electric Co Ltd made their trading debut on Thursday at HK$1.40 per share, compared with the issue price of HK$1.00.
The home appliance maker, a unit of Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd, issued 393.12 million shares in an initial public offering in Hong Kong.

Twenty percent of the issue was offered to existing shareholders of its parent in the proportion of one company share for every 50 parent shares held and one free company warrant for every 30 parent shares.
The public offer portion of 275.18 million shares was 112.57 times subscribed. The balance of 39.3 million shares were allotted to Leading Spirit Conrowa employees.
The company said it would use the proceeds to expand production capacity and set up outlets, augmenting its existing distribution network of more than 330 specialty shops in China.
